# 3. process data and filtering
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# ================================
# 3. Data import and preprocessing function
# ================================
read_phyloseq_data <- function(paths) {
  # Read ASV table
  asv <- read_tsv(paths$asv_table, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    column_to_rownames("OTU.ID")
  
  # Read taxonomic information
  tax <- read_tsv(paths$tax_table, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Feature ID") %>%
    tidyr::separate(Taxon, sep = ";", into = paste0("Rank_", 1:7)) %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(~c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"), 
                       starts_with("Rank_"))
  
  # Read metadata
  metadata <- read_tsv(paths$metadata, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    column_to_rownames("SampleID")
  
  # Standardize sample names
  colnames(asv) <- gsub("_(Soil|Rhizo|Root)$", "", colnames(asv))
  rownames(metadata) <- gsub("_(Soil|Rhizo|Root)$", "", rownames(metadata))
  
  # Validate data consistency
  common_samples <- intersect(colnames(asv), rownames(metadata))
  if (length(common_samples) == 0) {
    stop("No shared samples between ASV table and metadata: ", paths$asv_table)
  }
  
  # Construct phyloseq components
  refseqs <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(paths$refseq_fa)
  
  list(
    asv = asv[, common_samples, drop = FALSE],
    tax = tax,
    metadata = metadata[common_samples, , drop = FALSE],
    refseqs = refseqs
  )
}

# ================================
# 4. Create phyloseq object
# ================================
make_phyloseq <- function(data) {
  phyloseq::phyloseq(
    otu_table = otu_table(as.matrix(data$asv), taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
    tax_table = tax_table(as.matrix(data$tax)),
    sample_data = sample_data(data$metadata),
    refseq = data$refseqs
  )
}

# ================================
# 5. Data loading and quality control
# ================================
# Load data from three environments
data_RS <- read_phyloseq_data(data_paths$RS)
data_Root <- read_phyloseq_data(data_paths$Root)
data_Soil <- read_phyloseq_data(data_paths$Soil)

# Create phyloseq objects
ps_RS <- make_phyloseq(data_RS)
ps_Root <- make_phyloseq(data_Root)
ps_Soil <- make_phyloseq(data_Soil)

# Add sample origin metadata
sample_data(ps_RS)$Origin <- "Rhizosphere"
sample_data(ps_Root)$Origin <- "Endosphere"
sample_data(ps_Soil)$Origin <- "Soil"



```


# 4. merge all data and name it meta_data
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# 6.2 Merge phyloseq objects
meta_seq <- merge_phyloseq(ps_RS, ps_Root, ps_Soil)

# 6.3 Define taxonomic filtering function (enhanced robustness)
filter_contaminants <- function(ps) {
  # Extract taxonomy table
  taxa <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps))
  
  # Create logical keep vector (handling NA values)
  keep <- apply(taxa, 1, function(row) {
    !any(
      grepl("mitochondria|Chlorophyll|Unassigned|Archaea", 
            row, 
            ignore.case = TRUE,
            fixed = FALSE),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  })
  
  # Force logical conversion and validate length
  keep <- as.logical(keep)
  if (length(keep) != ntaxa(ps)) {
    stop("Filter vector length does not match number of taxa")
  }
  
  # Apply filtering
  subset_taxa(ps, keep)
}

# 6.5 Remove zero-abundance entries
meta_seq_clean <- prune_samples(sample_sums(meta_seq) > 0, meta_seq)
meta_seq_clean <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(meta_seq_clean) > 0, meta_seq_clean)

# 6.6 Final validation
cat("Number of samples after merging:", nsamples(meta_seq_clean), "\n")
cat("Number of taxa after merging:", ntaxa(meta_seq_clean), "\n")

print(tax_table(meta_seq)[1:5, ])        # Inspect first 5 taxa before filtering
print(tax_table(meta_seq_clean)[1:5, ])  # Inspect first 5 taxa after filtering

# Save result (optional)
saveRDS(meta_seq_clean, "merged_and_filtered_phyloseq.rds")


```

# 6.1 PcoA of Clay
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)

# 1. Subset to Clay + selected Treatments
meta_clay_sel <- subset_samples(
  meta_seq_clean,
  Soil_Type == "Clay" &
    Treatment %in% c("Control", "Bradyrhizobium", "SC3", "SC6", "SC4")
)

# Remove empty taxa
meta_clay_sel <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(meta_clay_sel) > 0, meta_clay_sel)

# 2. Bray-Curtis distance
bray_dist_clay_sel <- phyloseq::distance(meta_clay_sel, method = "bray")

# 3. Extract metadata for PERMANOVA
meta_df <- as(sample_data(meta_clay_sel), "data.frame")

# ==============================
# 4. STRICT PERMANOVA (Origin)
# ==============================
set.seed(123)

permanova_res <- adonis2(
  bray_dist_clay_sel ~ Origin,
  data = meta_df,
  permutations = 9999,
  by = "margin"
)

permanova_res

# Extract statistics
pval <- permanova_res$`Pr(>F)`[1]
r2   <- permanova_res$R2[1]

p_label <- paste0(
  "PERMANOVA (Origin)\n",
  "p = ", signif(pval, 3),
  "\nR² = ", signif(r2, 3)
)

# 5. PCoA ordination
pcoa_ord_clay_sel <- ordinate(
  meta_clay_sel,
  method = "PCoA",
  distance = bray_dist_clay_sel
)

# 6. Colors (unchanged)
treatment_colors <- c(
  "Control"        = "#FDE725FF",
  "Bradyrhizobium" = "#7AD151FF",
  "SC6"        = "#31688EFF",
  "SC3"        = "#3F4A8EFF",
  "SC4"        = "#440154FF"
)

# 7. Shapes for Origin (key variable now tested)
origin_shapes <- c(
  "Soil" = 3,
  "Rhizosphere" = 16,
  "Endosphere" = 17
)

# ==============================
# 8. Plot
# ==============================
Clay <- plot_ordination(
  meta_clay_sel,
  pcoa_ord_clay_sel,
  color = "Treatment",
  shape = "Origin"
) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = Treatment),
               type = "t",
               linetype = 2,
               linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = treatment_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = origin_shapes) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = p_label,
    hjust = 1.1,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PCoA — Clay Soil (Origin Effect Tested)",
    color = "Treatment",
    shape = "Origin"
  )

print(Clay)

# ==============================
# 9. Save PDF
# ==============================
output_folder <- "/Data/to/path"

if (!dir.exists(output_folder)) {
  dir.create(output_folder, recursive = TRUE)
}

output_file <- file.path(output_folder, "Clay_PCoA_Origin_PERMANOVA.pdf")

ggsave(
  filename = output_file,
  plot = Clay,
  width = 14,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300,
  units = "cm",
  device = "pdf"
)


```

#7. Alpha diversity: soil-specific ANOVA and Tukey comparisons
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}


library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(viridis)
library(multcompView)
library(patchwork)

# -------------------------------
# 1. Select the sample compartment
# -------------------------------
target_origin <- "Endosphere"
# Other options: "Rhizosphere" or "Soil"

ps_alpha <- subset_samples(
  meta_seq_clean,
  Origin == target_origin
)

ps_alpha <- prune_samples(
  sample_sums(ps_alpha) > 0,
  ps_alpha
)

# -------------------------------
# 2. Calculate alpha diversity
# -------------------------------
alpha_df <- estimate_richness(
  ps_alpha,
  measures = c("Observed", "Shannon")
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID")

metadata_df <- as(
  sample_data(ps_alpha),
  "data.frame"
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID")

# Match diversity measurements to metadata by sample ID.
datar16S_clean <- left_join(
  alpha_df,
  metadata_df,
  by = "SampleID"
) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = recode(
      as.character(Treatment),
      SC3 = "SynCom3",
      SC4 = "SynCom4",
      SC6 = "SynCom6"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Soil_Type),
    Treatment %in% c(
      "Control", "Bradyrhizobium",
      "SynCom3", "SynCom4", "SynCom6"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c(
        "Control", "Bradyrhizobium",
        "SynCom3", "SynCom4", "SynCom6"
      )
    ),
    Soil_Type = factor(Soil_Type)
  )

if (nrow(datar16S_clean) == 0) {
  stop("No samples remain after compartment and treatment selection.")
}

print(with(datar16S_clean, table(Soil_Type, Treatment)))

# -------------------------------
# 3. Run separate tests within soils
# -------------------------------
run_soil_tests <- function(data, response) {

  soil_groups <- split(
    data,
    data$Soil_Type,
    drop = TRUE
  )

  results <- lapply(names(soil_groups), function(soil) {

    df <- soil_groups[[soil]]
    df <- df[is.finite(df[[response]]), , drop = FALSE]
    df <- droplevels(df)

    if (
      nlevels(df$Treatment) < 2 ||
      nrow(df) <= nlevels(df$Treatment)
    ) {
      stop(
        "Insufficient observations for ",
        response, " analysis in ", soil
      )
    }

    model <- aov(
      reformulate("Treatment", response = response),
      data = df
    )

    if (!is.finite(deviance(model)) || deviance(model) <= 0) {
      stop("No residual variation for ", response, " in ", soil)
    }

    tukey <- TukeyHSD(
      model,
      which = "Treatment"
    )

    letters <- multcompView::multcompLetters4(
      model,
      tukey
    )$Treatment$Letters

    values <- df[[response]]
    offset <- 0.08 * max(
      diff(range(values)),
      abs(values),
      1
    )

    annotations <- data.frame(
      Soil_Type = soil,
      Treatment = names(letters),
      Letters = unname(letters),
      y = max(values) + offset,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    list(
      model = model,
      tukey = tukey,
      annotations = annotations
    )
  })

  names(results) <- names(soil_groups)

  list(
    results = results,
    annotations = bind_rows(
      lapply(results, function(x) x$annotations)
    )
  )
}

observed_tests <- run_soil_tests(
  datar16S_clean,
  "Observed"
)

shannon_tests <- run_soil_tests(
  datar16S_clean,
  "Shannon"
)

# Display ANOVA and Tukey results for each soil.
for (soil in names(observed_tests$results)) {

  cat("\n=== Observed richness:", soil, "===\n")
  print(summary(observed_tests$results[[soil]]$model))
  print(observed_tests$results[[soil]]$tukey)

  cat("\n=== Shannon diversity:", soil, "===\n")
  print(summary(shannon_tests$results[[soil]]$model))
  print(shannon_tests$results[[soil]]$tukey)
}

# -------------------------------
# 4. Plot diversity measurements
# -------------------------------
plot_alpha <- function(data, response, annotations, y_label) {

  ggplot(
    data,
    aes(
      x = Treatment,
      y = .data[[response]],
      color = Treatment
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      size = 1,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~Soil_Type) +
    scale_color_viridis(
      discrete = TRUE,
      option = "viridis",
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = annotations,
      aes(
        x = Treatment,
        y = y,
        label = Letters
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      size = 4
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(target_origin, "-", y_label),
      x = NULL,
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      ),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

set.seed(123)

Plot_16S_Observed <- plot_alpha(
  datar16S_clean,
  "Observed",
  observed_tests$annotations,
  "Observed ASV richness"
)

Plot_16S_Shannon <- plot_alpha(
  datar16S_clean,
  "Shannon",
  shannon_tests$annotations,
  "Shannon diversity"
)

Fig1 <- (
  Plot_16S_Observed + Plot_16S_Shannon
) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(Fig1)

# -------------------------------
# 5. Save data, statistics, and plots
# -------------------------------
output_folder <- "/Data/to/path/Analysis"

dir.create(
  output_folder,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  datar16S_clean,
  file.path(
    output_folder,
    paste0("Alpha_diversity_", target_origin, ".csv")
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    Observed = observed_tests,
    Shannon = shannon_tests
  ),
  file.path(
    output_folder,
    paste0("Alpha_diversity_statistics_", target_origin, ".rds")
  )
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_folder,
    paste0("Alpha_diversity_", target_origin, ".pdf")
  ),
  plot = Fig1,
  width = 16,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  device = "pdf"
)






```





#8 Create box plot to visulize the relative abundance of samples in family level
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}


library(reshape2)
library(ggsci)
library(colorspace)
library(dplyr)
library(phyloseq)
library(tibble)  # for rownames_to_column
packageVersion("reshape2")
source("/Path/to/data/graphical_methods.R")

# ---- Step 1: Prepare sample data as dataframe with SampleID ----
sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(d16S)) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "SampleID")

# Extract treatment names from sample names (everything before last underscore)
treatment_vector <- sub("_\\d+$", "", sample_names(d16S))
sample_df$Treatment <- treatment_vector



# ---- Step 2: Add "Endosphere_, Rhizosphere_ or Soil_" prefix to Treatment column in filtered_samples ----
filtered_samples$Treatment <- paste0("Endosphere_/Rhizosphere_/Soil_", filtered_samples$Treatment)

# ---- Step 3: Update d16S sample_data Treatment using SampleID ----
sample_data(d16S)[filtered_samples$SampleID, "Treatment"] <- filtered_samples$Treatment

# ---- Step 5: Subset the phyloseq object to keep only filtered samples ----
d16S <- prune_samples(filtered_samples$SampleID, d16S)

# ---- Step 6: Relevel the Treatment factor in d16S (Endosphere_,Rhizosphere_ or Soil_)----
sample_data(d16S)$Treatment <- factor(sample_data(d16S)$Treatment,
  levels = c("Endosphere_C_Control", "Endosphere_C_Bradyrhizobium", "Endosphere_C_SynCom3", "Endosphere_C_SynCom4", "Endosphere_C_SynCom6",
             "Endosphere_L_Control", "Endosphere_L_Bradyrhizobium", "Endosphere_L_SynCom3", "Endosphere_L_SynCom4", "Endosphere_L_SynCom6",
             "Endosphere_S_Control", "Endosphere_S_Bradyrhizobium", "Endosphere_S_SynCom3", "Endosphere_S_SynCom4", "Endosphere_S_SynCom6")
)

# ---- Step 7: Remove "Unknown" taxa ----
d16S <- subset_taxa(d16S, Family != "Unknown")

# ---- Step 8: Define QIIME2-inspired color palette ----
qiime2_colors <- c(
  "#ff7f0e",  # A21b
  "#d62728",  # Burkholderiaceae
  "#9467bd",  # Caulobacteraceae
  "#8c564b",  # Comamonadaceae
  "#6a3d9a",  # Ilumatobacteraceae
  "#98df8a",  # Methylophilaceae
  "#b15928",  # Micromonosporaceae
  "#c7c7c7",  # Nocardioidaceae
  "#dbdb8d",  # Oxalobacteraceae
  "#a6cee3",  # Propionibacteriaceae
  "#fb9a99",  # Pseudomonadaceae
  "#9edae5",  # Rhizobiaceae
  "#393b79",  # Rhodanobacteraceae
  "#8c6d31",  # SC−I−84
  "#17becf",  # Sphingomonadaceae
  "#9c9ede",  # Streptomycetaceae
  "#fdbf6f",  # Thermomonosporaceae
  "#b2df8a",  # Unknown_Family
  "#cedb9c",  # Xanthobacteraceae
  "#bd9e39",  # Xanthomonadaceae
  "#636363"   # Other
)

# ---- Step 9: Plot composition ----
tax16S <- plot_composition(d16S, "Kingdom", "Bacteria", "Family", numberOfTaxa=20, fill="Family") + 
  facet_wrap(~Soil_Type, scales="free_x", nrow=1) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        strip.background = element_rect(color="white", fill="white", size=1),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=3),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  ylab("Relative abundance (%)") + 
  ggtitle("Taxonomy - 16S") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = qiime2_colors)

# ---- Step 10: Add bar outlines ----
tax16S_RS <- tax16S + geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "gray90", size = 0.02)

# ---- Step 11: Save plot ----
output_file <- "Data/to/path/Relative abundance/Relative abundance_Endo.pdf"

ggsave(
  filename = output_file,
  plot = tax16S_RS,
  device = "pdf",
  width = 20,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)







```
